contentPattern.structure: repeating feature rows: label | value (text or tick/cross badge)

suitableFor: spec tables with boolean tick/cross values

implementationNote: Block-based component (resourceType block/v1/block) with repeating comparison-row items (label + richtext value). Renders a <table>; affirmative/negative value tokens become tick/cross badges. Named comparison-table (not columns-*) so md2jcr keeps the variant class.
